description:
One number from one device at one moment. This is the highest-volume record this app writes and it is deliberately the thinnest: a device, a type, a value, a unit, a timestamp and a quality flag.

QUALITY IS A COLUMN AND NOT A FILTER APPLIED BEFORE STORAGE. A reading the gateway thought was wrong is still what the sensor said, and the run of suspect values either side of a real event is often the only evidence the event happened. Storing it and marking it lets a reader exclude it; dropping it at the door means nobody can ever ask.

THE FIELD IS DENORMALISED FROM THE DEVICE ON PURPOSE. A device moved between blocks in July must not retroactively move June's readings, and a link resolved at read time would do exactly that.

fields.description: Copied from the device on save.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Copied from the device AT THE MOMENT THE READING IS WRITTEN, and never resolved afterwards. See the doctype description.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: When the device took the measurement — NOT when the server received it. The two differ by hours for a device that buffered while offline, and the buffered ones are exactly the readings somebody needs during a frost event.
fields.label: Timestamp

fields.description: What was measured. A closed list, because a free-text reading type makes every average a string-matching exercise. `generic` is the honest escape hatch and carries its meaning in the unit.
fields.label: Reading Type
fields.options:
soil_moisture_vwc
soil_temp_c
flow_gallons
air_temp_c
humidity_pct
wind_speed_kmh
rain_mm
leaf_wetness_pct
solar_radiation_wm2
generic

fields.description: The measurement itself. Four decimals because volumetric water content is a fraction and rounding it to two loses the change that matters.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: The unit the value is in — '%', 'C', 'gal', 'mm'. REQUIRED even though the reading type implies it: a device reporting Fahrenheit into an air_temp_c column is a real failure and the unit is the only place it shows.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: What the gateway or the ingest path thought of this value. `Suspect` is out of the expected band but physically possible; `Error` is a sensor fault code or a value that cannot exist.
fields.label: Quality
